All other tickers in this file are still on Friday's stale data pending Alpha Vantage's next close.

market_prices.notes: Prices are the last completed trading day's close (2026-08-14 — Alpha Vantage's markets were closed for the weekend by the time this was fetched on 2026-08-17), not real-time intraday; the free tier is always delayed to the prior close, never live-intraday. VWRP.LON is the one exception as of 17/08/2026: manually overridden with Luke's live IBKR intraday price (144.72) against Friday's actual close (144.34), since Alpha Vantage hadn't posted a Monday close yet. The other 11 tickers are still showing Friday-vs-Thursday's move, not today's — 'Today's Unrealised Swing' is only truly live for VWRP right now; the rest will refresh once Alpha Vantage's next close posts. IMPORTANT: CSP1.LON is quoted by Alpha Vantage in GBX (pence), not GBP, unlike the other five LSE ETFs here which are already in whole pounds — cross-checked against the actual IBKR statement close_price (£618.87) to confirm and convert; if a future refresh ever shows CSP1 in the hundreds-of-pounds range again check this hasn't silently reverted to raw pence. FX rate is Alpha Vantage's own live USD/GBP rate (CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE), refreshed each time this file is rebuilt, not the stale HL-statement FX rate used previously. NOT COVERED, deliberately: (1) SpaceX — private company, will never have a public quote; (2) the Vanguard FTSE Global All Cap Index fund (held across GIA, ISA and SIPP) — an open-ended OEIC/mutual fund, not exchange-traded, so no ticker exists on this or any comparable real-time quote API; (3) Argo Blockchain — has a Nasdaq ADS ticker (ARBK) but the company is mid-restructuring: its ADS-to-ordinary-share ratio just changed from 1:10 to 1:2,160 and it's delisting from the LSE entirely, so any price derived from ARBK right now risks being wrong by orders of magnitude — left out rather than guessed, consistent with HL's own statement already excluding it from totals for the same reason. This file is rebuilt manually by fetching fresh Alpha Vantage quotes during a Cowork session — it does not refresh automatically when Luke runs the local Refresh Dashboard.bat script, since that script has no API key of its own.
